criteria_results.title: ACA references UCC § 8-106 and establishes securities account control
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 2.2 and 3.1 establish securities account control under UCC 8-106(d)(2).

criteria_results.title: Sovereign agrees to comply with Indenture Trustee entitlement orders without Issuer consent
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 3.1 has Sovereign comply with Indenture Trustee entitlement orders without further consent of the Issuer.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: ACA includes UCC § 9-104 control for deposit accounts
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 2.3 and 3.2 establish 9-104(a)(2) deposit account control, complying with Indenture Trustee instructions without Issuer consent.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Sovereign agrees to act in dual capacity (securities intermediary and bank)
criteria_results.reasoning: The preamble, Sec. 2.2/2.3 and 8.1(d)-(e) state Sovereign acts as both securities intermediary and bank.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Cover memo explains dual UCC characterization departure
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 1 identifies dual characterization as a departure and explains that uninvested cash needs 9-104 control.

criteria_results.title: ACA includes waiver of setoff, recoupment, and banker's lien
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 7.1 expressly waives setoff, recoupment, banker's lien and similar rights against all Accounts.

criteria_results.title: Anti-setoff waiver is absolute, not merely a subordination
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 7.1 states it is a waiver and extinguishment, not merely a subordination.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: ACA removes Sovereign's lien on account assets for unpaid fees
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 7.1 states the standard-form fee lien is not part of the Agreement and prohibits debiting Accounts for fees.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo identifies removal of Sovereign's fee lien and/or anti-setoff waiver as material departure
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 2 identifies deletion of the fee lien and the addition of the absolute waiver as a material departure.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo explains Rating Agency and Base Indenture basis for lien removal/anti-setoff waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites Clearwater pre-sale III.D requiring an absolute waiver and discusses Indenture 3.01(e) (Flag A).

criteria_results.title: ACA defines Exclusive Control Notice
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 1.1 defines Exclusive Control Notice.

criteria_results.title: Exclusive Control Notice may be delivered by Indenture Trustee upon Event of Default
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 5.1 lets the Indenture Trustee deliver an ECN upon an Event of Default.

criteria_results.title: ACA specifies delivery mechanism for Exclusive Control Notice
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 5.1 and Schedule B specify written delivery, by email PDF or courier, to a named contact.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Upon Exclusive Control Notice, Sovereign ceases following non-Indenture Trustee instructions
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 5.2 requires Sovereign to cease immediately complying with anyone other than the Indenture Trustee, including the Servicer.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Post-ECN, Servicer Fee withdrawals require Indenture Trustee authorization
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 5.3(b) bars Servicer Fee withdrawals after an ECN except on Indenture Trustee instruction.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: ACA addresses securities intermediary jurisdiction for UCC Article 8
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 2.4(a) elects New York by express agreement under 8-110(e)(1), acknowledging the Boston chief executive office.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Cover memo explains jurisdiction mismatch and resolution
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 4 discusses the New York designation against the Boston chief executive office and explains the deliberate 8-110(e) election.

criteria_results.title: ACA addresses Reserve Account step-down trigger from 1.50% to 1.00%
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6 and the definitions cover the step-down from $5,775,000 to $3,850,000 when the Pool Factor falls below 50%.

criteria_results.title: ACA identifies who determines when step-down trigger is met
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6.2 makes the Servicer determine and certify that the Pool Factor is below 50%, subject to an Indenture Trustee objection right.

criteria_results.title: ACA addresses release of excess reserve funds ($1,925,000) upon step-down
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6.2(d) and 6.4 provide for releasing the excess, which is $1,925,000 if the account is fully funded.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Excess reserve funds released to Distribution Account
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6.4 requires transfer to the Distribution Account only.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Resignation requires appointment of qualified successor
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 12.1 makes resignation ineffective until a Qualified Institution successor is appointed and has executed the documentation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Resigning Securities Intermediary must continue serving if no qualified successor found
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 12.2 requires Sovereign to continue serving until the Succession Conditions are satisfied.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Cover memo explains modification of resignation provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 5 identifies the change to the 30-day resignation provision and ties it to the Qualified Institution and successor requirement.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Investment proceeds must remain in originating account
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.4(a) requires earnings and proceeds to be credited to the originating Account.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: ACA prohibits commingling of investment proceeds across accounts
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.4(a) expressly prohibits commingling earnings with any other Account.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Amendment provision requires 10 business days' notice to Rating Agency
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 15.2 requires 10 Business Days' prior written notice to Clearwater, including for adverse amendments.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Cover memo explains Rating Agency amendment notice requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 9 and Flag D identify the notice requirement as an addition and tie it to Clearwater pre-sale IV and Indenture 10.16.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: ACA modifies Sovereign's liability cap from $45,000
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 11.3 raises the cap to the greater of 12 months of fees and $15M, with carve-outs for gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and the setoff waiver.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Cover memo explains inadequacy of Sovereign's liability cap
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 7 identifies the $45,000 cap (0.0117% of $385M) as a departure, explains why it is inadequate, and modifies it.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Successor approval right runs to Indenture Trustee, not Sovereign
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 12.4 has the Indenture Trustee select the successor, and the outgoing bank has no approval right.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Cover memo explains reversal of successor approval right
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 6 identifies deletion of Sovereign's 'reasonably acceptable' right and that Crestline appoints, but gives no rationale for why the secured party/noteholder representative should control successor selection.

criteria_results.title: Pre-ECN, Servicer may direct Eligible Investments
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.1(a) and 3.4(a)(i) give the Servicer pre-ECN authority to direct Eligible Investments.

criteria_results.title: Post-ECN, only Indenture Trustee may provide investment instructions
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.1(b) gives the Indenture Trustee sole investment authority after an ECN.

criteria_results.title: ACA includes notice address for Crestline National Bank

criteria_results.title: ACA includes fee schedule

criteria_results.title: ACA includes form of Exclusive Control Notice
criteria_results.reasoning: Exhibit C contains the form of Exclusive Control Notice.

criteria_results.title: ACA references the Base Indenture correctly
criteria_results.reasoning: The recitals reference the Base Indenture dated April 15, 2025 with the Indenture Trustee.

criteria_results.title: ACA references the Servicing Agreement correctly
criteria_results.reasoning: The recitals reference the Servicing Agreement with Granite Peak Capital LLC as Servicer.

criteria_results.title: Sovereign acknowledges subordination of its claims to Indenture Trustee/noteholders
criteria_results.reasoning: In Sec. 7.3, Sovereign acknowledges its claims are subordinate to the Indenture Trustee and Noteholders.

criteria_results.title: ACA addresses Eligible Investments definition or cross-reference
criteria_results.reasoning: Eligible Investments is cross-referenced to Indenture Sec. 1.01.

criteria_results.title: Sovereign agrees accounts are 'securities accounts' under UCC § 8-501
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 2.2(a) and 8.1(d) state that each Account is a securities account under 8-501(a).

criteria_results.title: ACA includes Qualified Institution requirement for account maintenance
criteria_results.reasoning: Qualified Institution is defined with the A/A-1 Clearwater ratings; Sec. 8.1(g) and 12.3 require maintenance at a Qualified Institution.

criteria_results.title: ACA execution date is April 15, 2025 (Closing Date)
criteria_results.reasoning: The Agreement is dated as of April 15, 2025, the Closing Date.

criteria_results.title: ACA provides Servicer pre-ECN authority to instruct deposits into Collection Account
criteria_results.reasoning: Permitted Servicer Instructions (Sec. 3.4) cover investments, Collection-to-Distribution transfers, Servicer Fee and reserve releases; nothing gives the Servicer pre-ECN authority to instruct deposits into the Collection Account.

criteria_results.title: ACA provides Servicer pre-ECN authority to instruct transfers from Collection Account to Distribution Account
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 3.4(a)(ii) lets the Servicer instruct Collection-to-Distribution transfers on the Transfer Date, defined as the second Business Day before the Payment Date.

criteria_results.title: Reserve Account initial required amount is $5,775,000
criteria_results.reasoning: The initial Required Reserve Amount is stated as $5,775,000 (1.50% of $385M).

criteria_results.title: Both deliverables are produced
criteria_results.reasoning: Both the ACA and a separate cover memo were produced.

criteria_results.title: ACA includes signature blocks for all necessary parties
criteria_results.reasoning: There are signature blocks for the Issuer, Servicer, Crestline and Sovereign.

criteria_results.title: ACA addresses Sovereign's disclaimer of consequential damages
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 11.4 carves gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud out of the consequential-damages disclaimer.
